scope: Explicit completed run only; saved file reads, deterministic gzip and hash verification; no host commands, GPU, build, test, or active worker-only trace reads.

ui.observation: not_run; no report or stderr fabricated

audio.observation: not_run; no report or stderr fabricated

producer_snapshot_note: Producer sources were copied only when current bytes exactly matched their launch/result pins. Their original workspace paths remain unchanged in saved evidence; copy sources back to that layout before reproducing the orchestration.
excluded: No runtime/UI/audio binaries, model, WAV/F32 audio, stop marker, full-local kernel journal or independently derived audits.
raw_manifest_scope: All files created by this archive helper except raw-manifest.json itself. Later independent audits need their own manifest and eventual top-level manifest.
